name: Liam Tremblay
title: Junior Network Engineer
summary: Highly motivated Junior Network Engineer with a strong foundation in network infrastructure, security, and troubleshooting. Adept at supporting and maintaining enterprise-level networks, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. Eager to contribute technical expertise and grow within a dynamic IT environment.

bullets: Managed and maintained network infrastructure for 200+ employees across 3 office locations, ensuring 99.8% network uptime.
Configured and deployed Cisco routers and switches, enhancing network segment efficiency by 15%.
Provided first and second-tier network support, resolving an average of 40 network incidents per week.
Assisted in the implementation of new Fortinet firewall policies, improving network security posture by reducing unauthorized access attempts by 20%.
Monitored network performance and availability using SolarWinds, identifying and addressing potential issues proactively.
Performed routine network device backups and configuration management for over 100 devices, ensuring business continuity.
Collaborated with senior engineers on network upgrade projects, assisting with documentation and testing phases.
Diagnosed and resolved connectivity issues for internal users, improving user satisfaction scores by 10%.
Provided technical support for hardware, software, and basic network issues to over 300 clients.
Configured and maintained network printers, VoIP phones, and Wi-Fi access points.
Managed user accounts and access permissions on Active Directory and various network resources.
Assisted in basic network cabling and infrastructure setup for new office expansions.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Network Security
